questions.question_text: Which AI tool mentioned in the chapter is best suited for helping high school students polish their essays by checking grammar and suggesting style improvements?

options.text: Quizlet

questions.question_text: How can AI summarization tools likeQuillBotassist students with research projects, according to the chapter?

options.text: By writing complete research papers without student input
By condensing long articles into shorter summaries to highlight key points
By designing presentation slides for research topics
By creating flashcards for research termsCorrect Answer: B) By condensing long articles into shorter summaries to highlight key points

questions.question_text: What is a key benefit of using AI study tools likeQuizlet’sLearn mode for test preparation, as described in the chapter?

options.text: It automatically completes homework assignments
It adapts to your performance by focusing on areas you struggle with
It designs visual aids for presentations
It summarizes entire textbooks in one clickCorrect Answer: B) It adapts to your performance by focusing on areas you struggle with

questions.question_text: In the chapter, what is one wayCanva’sAI features help students create presentations?

options.text: By writing full speech scripts for presentations
By suggesting templates and images based on the topic
By solving math problems for slide content
By creating study flashcards for presentation topicsCorrect Answer: B) By suggesting templates and images based on the topic

questions.question_text: According to Section 5 of the chapter, when should students avoid using AI and rely on their own efforts?

options.text: When checking grammar or formatting documents
When brainstorming initial ideas for a project
When doing core thinking or analysis for an assignment
When summarizing long articles for researchCorrect Answer: C) When doing core thinking or analysis for an assignment

questions.question_text: What is an important tip from the chapter for maintaining a balance between using AI tools and doing schoolwork yourself?

options.text: Always let AI complete assignments to save time
Start with your own work before using AI as a supportive tool
Use AI for every part of an assignment to ensure high grades
Avoid using AI entirely to prevent plagiarism risksCorrect Answer: B) Start with your own work before using AI as a supportive tool
